entries.title: CHEST: LATERAL
entries.notes:
14X17 LW       SID: 72" 
CR: ⟂ to MCP at T7
Breath: Suspend at end of 2nd full inspiration

IR Top: 1.5-2” above shoulders
Coll: 1" border around skin line

Pos: Rest arms above head or hold bar (IV stand in front)
(Left Lateral preferred)

Eval: Include costophrenic angles & portions of pulmonary apices not obscured by arms.
No rotation: Hila in center, SI of ribs posterior to vertebral column, trachea visible in mid.
No forward or backward leaning on long axis of lung fields.
Open thoracic intervertebral joint spaces & intervertebral foramina (except with scoliosis).
Sternum in profile.
Sharp outlines of heart & diaphragm.
Pulmonary vascular markings from hilar regions to periphery of lungs.
